response.description:
Running
containerized workloads in shared environments can raise concerns around
security and workload isolation. To address this, AKS now supports pod
sandboxing, enabling customers to run containers in per-workload pod VMs. Each
pod VM is isolated from others and from the host, providing a strong compute
isolation boundary. This
feature enhances workload security by reducing the risk of cross-pod
interference and host-level vulnerabilities, making it ideal for multi-tenant
scenarios or sensitive applications.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Pod sandboxing on AKS
